case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment caption.

accused_age.reason: No accused age is stated in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of the accused is not mentioned.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of the accused is not mentioned.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status of the accused is not stated.

victim_gender.reason: Deceased is referred to with male pronouns and as the husband of P.W. 5.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the accused duly armed had entered the house of the deceased
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment describes intruders but never says they were strangers; the relationship is not expressly stated.

offence_category.reason: Core charge is murder under Section 302 read with Section 34.

weapon.reason: Accused used knives, as stated in the judgment.

evidence_type.quote: as supported by the medical evidence
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness and medical evidence are referenced; circumstantial evidence is not identified as an evidence type.

confession.reason: No confession is mentioned in the judgment.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Midnight armed entry, repeated knife use, injuries to witnesses and threats are all in the judgment.

mitigating_circumstances.correct_value: High Court treated A-2's blow as struck while extricating himself from the deceased's grip
mitigating_circumstances.quote: he dealt a knife blow in the process of extricating himself from the clutches of the deceased
mitigating_circumstances.reason: The High Court relied on this extrication reasoning, which functions as a mitigating point, so 'None noted' is incomplete.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted under 302/34, 460 and 324 IPC.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court modified conviction to Section 304 Part I and acquitted under Section 302.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court restored the trial court's conviction, so the accused stand convicted.

offence_finally_established.reason: Supreme Court restored the trial court's Section 302 finding.

imprisonment_type.quote: convicted and sentenced the accused under Sections 302/34, 460 and 324
imprisonment_type.reason: The judgment gives no sentence type or term; 'fixed_term' has no support.

imprisonment_years.quote: convicted and sentenced the accused under Sections 302/34, 460 and 324
imprisonment_years.reason: No number of years of imprisonment appears anywhere in the judgment.

fine_rs.reason: No fine amount is stated, so null is appropriate.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Accused were tied up with rope and police were informed; the judgment does not say they were handed over to police.
neutral_facts.quote: information was also sent to the police
neutral_facts.reason: Facts are largely accurate and do not reveal the outcome, but 'handed over to the police' is not stated.

offence_severity.reason: Minimum and maximum punishment ranges are not stated in the judgment.

attempt_completion.reason: Victim succumbed to injuries, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.reason: Judgment records the deceased's death and injuries to P.Ws. 1, 2 and 3.

number_of_offences.reason: Three charged offences; Supreme Court restored the trial court's convictions on all of them.

financial_property_loss.reason: The judgment states no property loss, so the value is consistent with what is stated.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Accused entered at midnight armed with intent to commit robbery; no explicit finding of premeditation is made.
premeditation_planning.quote: had entered the premises at mid night duly armed with the intention of committing robbery
premeditation_planning.reason: Court found armed entry with robbery intent, but never expressly found premeditation or planning.

motive.reason: The initial purpose of the intrusion was to commit robbery.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court accepted armed midnight entry for robbery and A-2's stomach injury causing death.

witness_credibility.correct_value: Court relied on in-court evidence of the deceased pinning A-2 and injuries to neighbours; no explicit credibility assessment is made.
witness_credibility.quote: It is also in evidence that the deceased had managed to pin A2 down to the ground
witness_credibility.reason: Court relied on the evidence but did not expressly assess witness credibility.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: P.Ws. 1 and 2 overpowered A-2 and pushed him from the balcony; neighbours seized A-1; both were tied with rope and police informed.
post_offence_conduct.quote: P.Ws.1 and 2 over powered A-2 and pushed him from balcony
post_offence_conduct.reason: Broadly accurate, but A-2 was overpowered by P.Ws. 1 and 2 rather than neighbours generally.

custody_duration.reason: Custody duration is not stated in the judgment.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence: night of 20th/21st November 1991; High Court judgment: 11.12.2003; Supreme Court decision: December 14, 2010. Trial court date not stated.
trial_duration.quote: Judgment & Order dated 11.12.2003 of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh
trial_duration.reason: 11.12.2003 is the High Court judgment date, not the trial judgment; the High Court date is wrongly marked not stated.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the appearance list in the judgment.

investigation_status.correct_value: Police informed; trial completed. FIR and charge sheet are not mentioned.
investigation_status.quote: information was also sent to the police
investigation_status.reason: Trial completion is supported, but FIR registration and charge sheet filing are not stated.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity is noted in the judgment.

appeal_history.reason: Trial, High Court and Supreme Court outcomes are accurately described.

prosecution_argument.quote: It is this part of the judgment which has been challenged by the State of Andhra Pradesh
prosecution_argument.reason: Judgment records no prosecution arguments; the listed content mirrors the court's own reasoning.

defence_argument.correct_value: Judgment records no defence arguments. High Court held no common intention to murder and blow was struck while extricating.
defence_argument.quote: The High Court has been influenced by the fact that there was no common intention
defence_argument.reason: No defence argument or 'unfortunate accident' claim is recorded; only the High Court's finding is stated.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Matches the court's holding that common intention can be inferred from circumstances arising during the incident.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: No precedent is cited in the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.correct_value: Court held the High Court's s.304 Part I view was erroneous and restored the trial court judgment; no sentence is stated.
sentencing_rationale.quote: We, therefore, feel that the High Court's observation that the matter fell under Section 304 Part I and not under Section 302 of the IPC is erroneous
sentencing_rationale.reason: Reasoning is correct, but no final sentence was imposed or stated in the judgment.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The court identified no mitigating factors.

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: Armed midnight entry with robbery intent; repeated effective knife use; injuries to neighbours and threats of dire consequences.
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: the two accused had entered the premises at mid night duly armed with the intention of committing robbery
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The court's reasoning relies on several aggravating features, so 'None' contradicts the judgment.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Set aside the High Court's Section 304 Part I part of the judgment and restored the trial court's judgment.
other_sentence_order.quote: We, accordingly, set aside this part of the High Court judgment and restore that of the trial court.
other_sentence_order.reason: The Supreme Court did set aside part of the High Court judgment and restored the trial court's order, so 'None' is wrong.
